name: Azure Cosmos DB
description: Globally distributed, multi-model database service from Microsoft that supports multiple data APIs and offers low-latency, scalable access.

name: Core Data
description: Apple framework for managing object graphs and persisting application data on iOS and macOS, providing an abstraction over underlying storage.

name: Couchbase
description: Distributed NoSQL database combining document store and key-value capabilities, designed for high performance and horizontal scalability.

name: IndexedDB
description: Low-level browser API for storing and indexing structured data on the client side, enabling offline and performant web applications.

name: MongoDB
description: Document-oriented NoSQL database that stores data as JSON-like documents, used for flexible-schema application development at scale.

name: Realm
description: Object-oriented mobile database framework for iOS and Android apps, often used as a local data store alternative to SQLite or Core Data.
